reviews.title: Awesome learning game
reviews.text: My kids loved crossy roads but it has so many ads and in-apps for virtual stuff that I see no real benefit besides killing time. This game is a better version of crossy roads as it has no ads or paying money for virtual stuff. Instead my kids solve math problems to unlock game and virtual stuff. I like the concept and my kids like it too.
